name: ArchON Forge
description: Describe architecture changes in plain language — an LLM agent edits your ArchON project through archon-mcp running in your browser.
author: Surecom
longDescription:
# ArchON Forge

A chat companion for ArchON (https://archon.su): describe a change, and an LLM agent applies it to your current project.

## How it works

- **Your project stays in the browser.** `archon-mcp` runs as a Web Worker inside the page; every tool call the model makes executes there.
- **One message = one undo step.** Everything a message changes is applied together after the model finishes, so Cmd/Ctrl+Z reverts the whole message. Stopping a run changes nothing.
- **Your current layer.** New elements land on the integration layer you are looking at, unless your message names another one.
- **Small asks stay small.** Forge is instructed to touch only what you mention — no silent re-layout, no tidying up.
- **Layout is yours.** The model cannot run auto layout; use the layout button in the Forge window when you want it.

## Providers

- **Cursor** — a Cursor agent with the model of your choice, through the ArchON bridge. Bring your own Cursor API key.
- Coming soon: DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Claude Code, on-prem LLMs (API key or login/password).

## Privacy

- Your API key is stored only in this browser's `localStorage` and sent with each request; the bridge holds it in memory for the duration of a run.
- Chat history lives in this browser's `IndexedDB`; clear it from the window header.

## Examples

- "Add a Payments system with an API and a database, and connect Orders API to it"
- "Rename Orders API to Order Service and add Kafka to its technologies"
- "Hide the Observability system on this layer"
